k7.change-boundaries: 按修改意图、依赖和审阅成本组织 diff 与 commit 边界；用于拆分候选或审查提交序列，不执行暂存、提交或推送。
k7.openruyi-contribution-style: 为 openRuyi commit、issue、PR 注入项目表达习惯及披露要求；用于起草或润色文字，不自行执行 GitHub 发布。
k7.obs-artifact-identity: 判断 OBS 源码、构建状态与 RPM 是否属于同一候选；用于解释旧产物、提交漂移和构建成功但来源不明的情况。
k7.git-change-series: 按已确定的边界暂存、提交、修订或推送 Git 主题分支；用于维护干净提交，不替调用者决定风格或自动创建 PR。
k7.github-contribution-operations: 使用 GitHub 公共 API 或 gh 查找、创建和更新 issue/PR，读取模板与评审；不自动合并，不将文字准备视为发布授权。
k7.docker-disposable-experiment: 用公共 Docker/OCI 接口运行调用者提供的实验并导出结果、清理自有环境；不限定 Docker 后端，也不自行规定业务验收。
k7.obs-build-artifacts: 查询指定 OBS 构建、读取日志或获取 SRPM 和二进制 RPM；可独立用于已有项目，不要求创建项目或触发新构建。
k7.downstream-patch-assessment: 判断升级后的下游补丁应保留、调整还是删除；用于补丁审阅与上游修复比对，也可只输出判断而不修改源码。
k7.validation-claims: 把原始检查结果转换为范围准确的验证结论；用于测试审阅、日志汇总、PR 证据选择，不将接受风险等同于检查通过。
k7.obs-source-configuration: 使用标准 OBS 接口分支指定软件包并配置精确 Git revision 的 source service；用于准备或更新个人验证项目，不自动扩展到发布。
k7.container-validation-boundaries: 区分 Docker 用户空间验证、跨架构模拟和目标内核验证；用于选实验环境或审阅测试结论，不要求启动容器。
k7.rpm-install-semantics: 解释 RPM 宏、安装清单和子包归属之间的关系；用于诊断缺失文件、未打包文件、重复归属及运行依赖。
k7.controlled-comparison: 设计或审查只改变关键变量的对照实验；适用于构建选项、升级回归、修复归因，不绑定 Docker、OBS 或某个软件包。
k7.openruyi-packaging-policy: 核对 openRuyi SPEC 改动适用的规范、补充规范和仓库检查；用于编辑或审阅打包文件，不负责执行完整发布流程。
k7.runtime-consumer-selection: 从真实依赖和链接关系选择运行时回归用例；适用于库或基础组件升级后的影响分析，避免只有版本输出的伪覆盖。
k7.reproducible-evidence: 保存可重建的实验输入和结果，并决定哪些临时资源可以清理；用于实验规划、交接和清理，不要求维持历史容器。

m2.change-boundaries: Organize diffs and commit boundaries by intent, dependency and review cost. Use to split candidates or review a series without staging, committing or pushing.
m2.openruyi-contribution-style: Apply openRuyi commit, issue and PR writing conventions and disclosure requirements when drafting or polishing text; do not publish to GitHub.
m2.obs-artifact-identity: Determine whether OBS sources, build status and RPMs belong to the same candidate. Use for stale artifacts, commit drift and successful builds with uncertain provenance.
m2.git-change-series: Stage, commit, amend or push a Git topic branch using established boundaries. Maintain clean commits without deciding the caller's style or automatically creating a PR.
m2.github-contribution-operations: Use public GitHub APIs or gh to find, create or update issues and PRs and read templates and reviews. Do not auto-merge or treat preparing text as publication authorization.
m2.docker-disposable-experiment: Run caller-provided experiments through public Docker/OCI interfaces, export results and clean up owned environments. Do not require a particular backend or define business acceptance criteria.
m2.obs-build-artifacts: Query OBS builds, read logs or retrieve source and binary RPMs. Works on existing projects without requiring project creation or triggering a new build.
m2.downstream-patch-assessment: Decide whether to retain, adapt or remove downstream patches after an upgrade. Use for patch review and upstream fix comparison, including analysis without editing sources.
m2.validation-claims: Translate raw checks into accurately scoped validation claims when reviewing tests, summarizing logs or choosing PR evidence; accepted risk is not a passing check.
m2.obs-source-configuration: Use standard OBS interfaces to branch a package and configure a source service pinned to an exact Git revision. Use for personal validation projects without extending into release publication.
m2.container-validation-boundaries: Distinguish Docker userspace checks, cross-architecture emulation and target-kernel validation when choosing an environment or reviewing test claims; no container launch is required.
m2.rpm-install-semantics: Explain RPM macros, installed manifests and subpackage ownership when diagnosing missing files, unpackaged files, duplicate ownership and runtime dependencies.
m2.controlled-comparison: Design or review experiments that change only the key variable. Use for build options, upgrade regressions and causal attribution without depending on Docker, OBS or a particular package.
m2.openruyi-packaging-policy: Check the openRuyi specifications, supplements and repository checks applicable to SPEC changes. Use for packaging edits or review, not a complete release workflow.
m2.runtime-consumer-selection: Select runtime regression cases from actual dependencies and linkage when analyzing library or base-component upgrades, avoiding coverage based only on version output.
m2.reproducible-evidence: Preserve inputs and results needed to reconstruct experiments and decide which temporary resources can be removed. Use for planning, handoff and cleanup without retaining historical containers.

p8.change-boundaries: 按修改意图和依赖拆分 diff，建议可审阅的提交边界。
p8.openruyi-contribution-style: 按 openRuyi 历史与模板起草或精简 commit、issue、PR 文字。
p8.obs-artifact-identity: 判断 OBS 的 RPM 是否来自指定提交，识别旧产物和来源漂移。
p8.git-change-series: 按确认的提交边界执行 Git 暂存、提交、修订或安全推送。
p8.github-contribution-operations: 查询、创建或更新指定 GitHub issue/PR，并读回确认结果。
p8.docker-disposable-experiment: 运行指定 Docker 实验，保存输出与退出状态，清理自有容器。
p8.obs-build-artifacts: 读取 OBS 构建状态、日志或下载指定构建的 RPM。
p8.downstream-patch-assessment: 判断下游补丁是否仍需要，或已被上游实现及构建选项替代。
p8.validation-claims: 审阅测试结论，区分通过、失败、环境不可用及未覆盖。
p8.obs-source-configuration: 在指定 OBS 项目分支软件包，配置 Git 来源与精确 revision。
p8.container-validation-boundaries: 判断 Docker 或跨架构模拟能覆盖哪些测试、哪些结论需要目标内核。
p8.rpm-install-semantics: 分析 RPM 路径宏、安装文件与子包归属不一致的问题。
p8.controlled-comparison: 用相同输入和受控变量设计升级、选项或修复的对照实验。
p8.openruyi-packaging-policy: 查 openRuyi SPEC 某项改动的现行规范与来源。
p8.runtime-consumer-selection: 为库升级选择真实消费者及有意义的运行操作和拒绝用例。
p8.reproducible-evidence: 确定实验需要保存的输入、结果和重建条件，支持清理后复现。

r4.change-boundaries: Split diffs by intent and dependency and recommend reviewable commit boundaries.
r4.openruyi-contribution-style: Draft or shorten commit, issue and PR text using openRuyi history and templates.
r4.obs-artifact-identity: Determine whether OBS RPMs came from a given commit; identify stale artifacts and source drift.
r4.git-change-series: Stage, commit, amend or safely push Git changes using confirmed commit boundaries.
r4.github-contribution-operations: Find, create or update a specified GitHub issue or PR and read it back to confirm the result.
r4.docker-disposable-experiment: Run a specified Docker experiment, save output and exit status, and clean up owned containers.
r4.obs-build-artifacts: Read OBS build status or logs, or download RPMs from a specified build.
r4.downstream-patch-assessment: Decide whether a downstream patch is still needed or superseded by upstream code or a build option.
r4.validation-claims: Review test claims and distinguish passed, failed, unavailable and untested coverage.
r4.obs-source-configuration: Branch an OBS package in a specified project and configure its Git source and exact revision.
r4.container-validation-boundaries: Determine what Docker or cross-architecture emulation can test and which claims require a target kernel.
r4.rpm-install-semantics: Diagnose mismatches between RPM path macros, installed files and subpackage ownership.
r4.controlled-comparison: Design controlled comparisons for upgrades, options or fixes using matched inputs and controlled variables.
r4.openruyi-packaging-policy: Find current openRuyi rules and sources for a specific SPEC change.
r4.runtime-consumer-selection: Choose real consumers, meaningful operations and rejection cases for a library upgrade.
r4.reproducible-evidence: Determine which inputs, results and reconstruction conditions to preserve for reproduction after cleanup.
